name: hud_ui_save_load_initialize_file_entries
description: HudUiSaveLoadDialog::InitializeFileEntries seeds save-list rows, refreshes save entries, and binds visible rows to filenames.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x434ee0 yet; the helper currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x434ee0 validates nine list item row-bias writes at offsets 0xb498 through 0xc9f8, a call to RefreshSaveFileList, iteration over fileEntries begin/end, up to nine row layoutX assignments, SetTextFmt(row, "%s", entry.cFileName), and SetVisible(row, 1).

The native smoke creates four SavedGames files, installs a fake list-item vtable, verifies the row-bias constants, verifies four text/visible calls in newest-first file order, and verifies row layoutX indices.
